fixes.why: C18 and C20, and C21 for CRO and trust. The bag is where 80% of adds are lost (FACTS: add to checkout about 20%), and its bottom line is the one figure that must never look broken. Today a two-piece bag at 360x640 opens with the lower 10px of the total's figure under a hairline (drawer_2.png); 26-32% of orders are two pieces or more (FACTS). Round 5's foot line caused it: in round 3 the same total sat whole above a foot at 511. A jeweller's bag pins the total beside the checkout, and lets scrolling lines fade out rather than be cut.

keep: Round 5's tall-screen picture source: the photographer's 3:4 frame on screens 2:1 and taller, and worn-720 everywhere else.
The first-screen column with its min-height and tight mode, so larger text never pushes COD under the bar or paints over the next section.
Inert states as text: '✓ In bag' and '✓ Added' right-aligned in the same 88x44 box, never in the primary's ink.
Slide 5's single plate in the chip's words, 'Riya's clip / Creator collaboration', or 'From Riya's reel' on a Riya landing.
text-wrap: pretty on running text, and the footer's deep sage ending on a straight edge above the bar.

The set: the condition said once and naming the bag, one 'Adds ₹X, not ₹Y' line per row, the ring first as the rhodium match, FACTS metal lines, '3 in stock' only where true, and the outlined 'Add all four'.
The spec table: 72px label column, values at x 100, and the 48px Fits row with its two links side by side.

The full after-add card: the bracelet first, 48px thumbnails, right-aligned prices, the ring's size range always shown, one suggestion in rupees, no timer, and the chip and counter hidden while it is open.
The bag's one-job lines: the next rung in rupees on top, the only 'automatic' in the ledger, the policy that opens in place, and the COD figure in rupees above the one 10px button.
Riya's 4:5 tiles with 32px marks clear of the bracelet and two-line captions, and the honest 3.3 s clip loaded only on tap.
The gallery arc (worn, macro, plaster, velvet, Riya, size, box), the quiet counter, and the viewer with the 896x1200 originals.
roadmap: Set thumbnails on one ground. The ring, necklace and hoops sit on terracotta, cream and grey. Reshoot or re-cut them on the bracelet's plaster and ivory so the set reads as one family (content).
Originals at least 1,440px wide for the viewer and DPR 3. Also Riya and velvet sources at least 720px wide: riya-540 and velvet-640 are upscaled 0.75x and 0.89x at DPR 2 (content).
A dimension-marked wrist photo (the bracelet on a wrist beside a tape) to replace the thin ruler slide, once ops have measured the real fit (launch blocker 1).
A 6-10 s product-only macro turn under light for the stones' colour play, and two or three more labelled creator clips (content).
The colour check, soft pink against lilac in Riya's footage, before any colour copy changes (owner and ops).

Merchandising: the set's earring is gold tone with saturated multicolour stones. If the catalogue holds a pastel or rhodium earring, the owner may prefer it as the set's fourth piece (owner's call; FACTS lists only these pairings today).
Reviews. Once a review app has real reviews for this piece, the Reviews block leads with them, and the WhatsApp, Instagram and address links move under them (owner and ops).
